item.title: [IGNITE-10069] SQL implicit schema is incorrectly resolved in native api.
item.description:
Without explicit schema declaration (either sql syntax SCHEMA.TABLE or SqlFieldsQuery#setSchema), do:
1) Create table using cache.query()
2) Perform select to this table

reproducer:

public void testSchema(){
        IgniteCache<?,?> c = ignite.getOrCreateCache("testCache");

        c.query(new SqlFieldsQuery("CREATE TABLE TEST1 (ID LONG PRIMARY KEY, VAL LONG) WITH \"template=replicated\";")).getAll();
        c.query(new SqlFieldsQuery("SELECT * FROM TEST1")).getAll();
    }

comments.comment: Also reproduced on latest master d5035bb23c2 (at this moment)

I think there are 2 problems:
1) bug itself
2) schema name is not presented in the exception message. Even if user have done typo in the schema name or have done incorrect assumtions about default schema, it's impossible to understand what full table name is resolved by ignite.
created IGNITE-10070

If we specify schema in only one query (either ddl or dml) - error the same.
If we specify in both queries - OK

It is important to use cache.query(), not IgniteEx#context()#query()#querySqlFields()
The root of the problem is the same as in IGNITE-10414 : "TESTCACHE" schema is used instead of "testCache"

Not reproduced. As pkouznet mentioned, probably fixed with IGNITE-10414. So I've only add one test.

vozerov, pkouznet, could you please take a look.
